symptom: VLAN setup could require an unnecessary managed Python build on a compatible PVE host
root_cause: The VLAN runner bypassed the shared native-runtime compatibility decision
resolution: Use the shared detector and accept compatible native Python before the legacy build fallback

symptom: A stale or incomplete snapshot could be treated as update-ready
root_cause: Snapshot readiness did not require the full live bridge member address and management-route topology
resolution: Fail closed and preserve the last complete update-ready snapshot

symptom: Bridge mutation risked partial state or management-path drift
root_cause: Discovery write apply verification and rollback were not one immutable transaction
resolution: Split the DATA-Link workflow into reviewed stages with backups identity revalidation and rollback

symptom: The candidate failed structure validation because rendered interface records were not real lines
root_cause: Escaped newline text crossed YAML Jinja and shell layers
resolution: Render the complete candidate from a dedicated template and reject literal backslash-n output

symptom: Canonical repair could duplicate or discard an existing selected physical NIC declaration
root_cause: Legacy cleanup handled the owned bridge without a complete external-stanza policy
resolution: Preserve zero or one manual IPv4 declaration and reject conflicting methods or duplicates

symptom: Production parsed the IPv4 method manual as ma
root_cause: Doubled control escapes in a negated regex class excluded literal n r and t while CI used a different copied parser
resolution: Move parsing policy rendering and validation into one production task include consumed by both the playbook and fixtures

symptom: ifreload returned duplicate-interface invalid-bridge-attribute and unrecognized-interface warnings even with a zero exit status
root_cause: Baseline repair evidence and generated-candidate acceptance were not separated and diagnostics could be flattened
resolution: Allow only identified owned legacy warnings as repair input then require both generated no-action checks to be warning-free while preserving diagnostic lines

symptom: Bare IPv4 input was rejected subnet addresses could be selected and duplicate detection failed late when arping was absent
root_cause: Host-address normalization assignability validation and dependencies were split across layers
resolution: Normalize bare input with an explicit default prefix reject subnet or broadcast addresses install and require iputils-arping and probe before preview and apply

symptom: Runtime-facts persistence failed with maximum recursion while resolving an overridable path
root_cause: An Ansible variable was defined in terms of itself through default()
resolution: Separate immutable defaults from caller values and resolve explicit effective paths before task arguments

symptom: PVE applied the NIC but verification failed and rolled it back because field order and generated values changed
root_cause: Raw serialized NIC strings were compared instead of parsed meaning
resolution: Use one production LXC NIC parser for no-op detection apply verification recovery rollback and fixtures

symptom: Firewall apply used unsupported policy scope and a second host firewall could conflict with Proxmox chains
root_cause: Cluster and node responsibilities were mixed and legacy host UFW remained an independent authority
resolution: Set default policy only at the supported cluster scope enable node policy separately and transactionally retire or restore host UFW

symptom: Rendered share selection could land under the wrong structured parent
root_cause: The generated YAML path was line-matched instead of parsed as a complete document
resolution: Render and parse the complete structure then validate final nesting and types

symptom: Runtime share facts could serialize with the wrong value shape
root_cause: Structured share state was not normalized before persistence
resolution: Serialize normalized share facts used by subsequent verification

symptom: Earlier documentation and runtime paths could produce separate read-only and read-write shares or fail after boot
root_cause: Share contract and boot-time DATA-Link readiness were implemented in separate evolving paths
resolution: Converge one operator-named guest-read authenticated-write share add a DATA-Link readiness guard and verify the parsed final smb.conf
